2:97.name: Set Actor target links
2:97.summary: Decodes two wrapper+4 Actor links and writes the encoded second pointer to firstActor+3384. The same value is written to firstActor+3392 only when the second Actor belongs to the active list, lacks state flags 0x10080000 and has DWORD+1244 equal to 1.
2:97.notes: When the conditional test fails, +3392 is left unchanged. There is no VM return slot or wrapper validation. List membership does not establish stable lifetime or ownership; downstream uses of these fields remain open. The immediate path does not modify Actor+1472/STATUS.
